items.source: Note that extended bean factories might support further scopes.
items.translation: 注意，扩展的 BeanFactory 可能支持更多的作用域。

items.source: The returned instance can be modified during bean factory post-processing.
items.translation: 返回的实例可以在 Bean 工厂后处理期间被修改。

items.source: This is just a minimal interface: The main intention is to allow a BeanFactoryPostProcessor to introspect and modify property values and other bean metadata.
items.translation: 这只是一个最小接口：主要目的是允许一个 BeanFactoryPostProcessor 检查并修改属性值和其他 Bean 元数据。

items.source: Note that this does not have to be the actual class name used at runtime, in case of a child definition overriding/inheriting the class name from its parent. Also, this may just be the class that a factory method is called on, or it may even be empty in case of a factory bean reference that a method is called on. Hence, do not consider this to be the definitive bean type at runtime but rather only use it for parsing purposes at the individual bean definition level.
items.translation: 请注意，在子定义覆盖或继承其父类的类名的情况下，这不必是运行时实际使用的真实类名。此外，这可能只是工厂方法被调用的类，或者在调用方法的工厂 Bean 引用为空时，它甚至可能是空的。因此，请勿将此视为运行时的最终 Bean 类型，而仅将其用于单个 Bean 定义级别的解析目的。

items.source: If false, the bean will get instantiated on startup by bean factories that perform eager initialization of singletons.
items.translation: 如果为false，则单例的 Bean 工厂将在启动时执行单例的急切初始化。

items.source: If this value is true for exactly one bean among multiple matching candidates, it will serve as a tie-breaker.
items.translation: 如果此值在多个匹配候选项中恰好对一个 Bean 为 `true`，它将作为决胜手段。

items.source: If this value is true for all beans but one among multiple matching candidates, the remaining bean will be selected.
items.translation: 如果此值在所有匹配候选项中除一个之外的所有 Bean 上都为 `true`，则选择剩余的 Bean。

items.source: This will be null for static factory methods which will be derived from the bean class instead.
items.translation: 这将对于从 Bean 类派生的静态工厂方法为 `null`。

items.source:
The class name can be modified during bean factory post-processing,
typically replacing the original class name with a parsed variant of it.
items.translation: 类名可以在 Bean 工厂后处理期间进行修改，通常是用其解析后的变体替换原始类名。

items.source:
Note that dependencies are normally expressed through bean properties or
constructor arguments. This property should just be necessary for other kinds
of dependencies like statics (*ugh*) or database preparation on startup.
items.translation: 请注意，依赖通常通过 Bean 属性或构造函数参数来表达。此属性应仅用于其他类型的依赖（例如静态类 [*ugh*]）或在启动时进行数据库准备。

items.source:
Note that this flag is designed to only affect type-based autowiring.
It does not affect explicit references by name, which will get resolved even
if the specified bean is not marked as an autowire candidate. As a consequence,
autowiring by name will nevertheless inject a bean if the name matches.
items.translation: 请注意，此标志仅影响基于类型的自动装配。它不会影响通过名称进行的显式引用；即使指定的 Bean 未标记为自动装配候选者，这些引用仍会被解析。因此，按名称进行自动装配时，只要名称匹配，就会注入一个 Bean。

items.source:
A factory bean name is only necessary for instance-based factory methods.
For static factory methods, the method will be derived from the bean class.
items.translation: 工厂 Bean 名称仅对基于实例的工厂方法而言是必需的。对于静态工厂方法，该方法将从 Bean 类中推导得出。

items.source:
This is typically fully resolved on a runtime-merged bean definition
but not necessarily on a configuration-time definition instance.
items.translation: 这通常在运行时合并的 Bean 定义上完全解析，但在配置时间定义实例上则不一定。

items.source: Allows for retrieving the decorated bean definition, if any.
items.translation: 允许获取装饰的 Bean 定义（如果有）。

items.source:
Note that this method returns the immediate originator. Iterate through the
originator chain to find the original BeanDefinition as defined by the user.
items.translation: 注意，此方法返回的是直接发起者。请遍历发起者链以找到用户定义的原始 BeanDefinition。

items.source: Role hint indicating that a BeanDefinition is a supporting part of some larger configuration, typically an outer ComponentDefinition. SUPPORT beans are considered important enough to be aware of when looking more closely at a particular ComponentDefinition, but not when looking at the overall configuration of an application.
items.translation: 指示 `BeanDefinition` 是某个更大配置的支持部分的角色提示，通常是外部 ComponentDefinition。当更仔细地查看特定的 ComponentDefinition 时，`SUPPORT` 类型的 Bean 被认为足够重要需要留意，但在查看应用程序的整体配置时则不需要。

items.source: Role hint indicating that a BeanDefinition is a supporting part of some larger configuration, typically an outer ComponentDefinition.
items.translation: 指示 `BeanDefinition` 是某个更大配置的支持部分的角色提示，通常是外部 ComponentDefinition。

items.source: Role hint indicating that a BeanDefinition is providing an entirely background role and has no relevance to the end-user. This hint is used when registering beans that are completely part of the internal workings of a ComponentDefinition.
items.translation: 指示 `BeanDefinition` 提供完全后台角色且与最终用户无关的角色提示。此提示用于注册完全属于 `ComponentDefinition` 内部工作机制的 Bean。

items.source: Set the role hint for this BeanDefinition. The role hint provides the frameworks as well as tools an indication of the role and importance of a particular BeanDefinition.
items.translation: 为此 `BeanDefinition` 设置角色提示。该角色提示为框架及工具提供关于特定 `BeanDefinition` 的角色和重要性的指示。

items.source: Get the role hint for this BeanDefinition. The role hint provides the frameworks as well as tools an indication of the role and importance of a particular BeanDefinition.
items.translation: 获取此BeanDefinition的角色提示。角色提示为框架以及工具提供有关特定BeanDefinition的角色和重要性的指示。

items.source: Return the name of the current target scope for this bean, or null if not known yet.
items.translation: 返回此 Bean 的当前目标作用域名称，如果尚不清楚则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return whether this a Prototype, with an independent instance returned for each call.
items.translation: 返回这是否为原型，每次调用时都返回一个独立的实例。

items.source: Return whether this a Singleton, with a single, shared instance returned on all calls.
items.translation: 返回这是否为Singleton，即所有调用均返回单个共享实例。

items.source: Role hint indicating that a BeanDefinition is a major part of the application. Typically corresponds to a user-defined bean.
items.translation: 指示 `<code>BeanDefinition` 是应用程序主要组成部分的角色提示。通常对应于用户定义的 Bean。

items.source: Return the bean names that this bean depends on.
items.translation: 返回此 Bean 所依赖的 Bean 名称。

items.source: Return a human-readable description of this bean definition.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 定义的易读描述。

items.source: Return the name of the destroy method.
items.translation: 返回销毁方法的名称。

items.source: Return a factory method, if any.
items.translation: 返回工厂方法（如果有）。

items.source: Return the name of the initializer method.
items.translation: 返回初始化方法的名称。

items.source: Return the name of the parent definition of this bean definition, if any.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 定义的父定义名称（如果有）。

items.source:
Return a description of the resource that this bean definition
came from (for the purpose of showing context in case of errors).
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 定义来源资源的描述（用于在出现错误时显示上下文）。

items.source: Return if there are constructor argument values defined for this bean.
items.translation: 如果为此 Bean 定义了构造函数参数值，则返回。

items.source: Return if there are property values defined for this bean.
items.translation: 如果该 Bean 定义了属性值，则返回。

items.source:
Return whether this bean is "abstract", that is, not meant to be instantiated
itself but rather just serving as parent for concrete child bean definitions.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 是否为“抽象”的，即不打算直接实例化它，而是仅作为具体子 Bean 定义的父类。

items.source: Return whether this bean is a candidate for getting autowired into some other bean.
items.translation: 返回此 Bean 是否为其他 Bean 进行自动注入的候选者。

items.source: Return whether this bean is a fallback autowire candidate.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 是否为回退自动装配候选者。

items.source: Return whether this bean is a primary autowire candidate.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 是否为主要的自动装配候选者。

items.source: Set a human-readable description of this bean definition.

items.source: Set the name of the destroy method.
items.translation: 设置销毁方法的名称。

items.source: Set the name of the initializer method.
items.translation: 设置初始化方法的名称。

items.source: Set the name of the parent definition of this bean definition, if any.
items.translation: 设置此 Bean 定义的父定义名称（如果有）。

items.source: Override the target scope of this bean, specifying a new scope name.
items.translation: 覆盖此 Bean 的目标作用域，指定一个新的作用域名称。

items.source:
Return whether this bean should be lazily initialized, i.e. not
eagerly instantiated on startup. Only applicable to a singleton bean.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 是否应延迟初始化，即不在启动时立即实例化。仅适用于单例 Bean。

items.source:
Specify a factory method, if any. This method will be invoked with
constructor arguments, or with no arguments if none are specified.
The method will be invoked on the specified factory bean, if any,
or otherwise as a static method on the local bean class.
items.translation: 指定工厂方法（如有）。此方法将使用构造函数参数调用，或者如果未指定任何参数则不带参数调用。该方法将在指定的工厂 Bean（如有）上调用，否则作为本地 Bean 类的静态方法进行调用。
